entries.zh: 相系相承、彼此相代；（“係”本义）系属、是
entries.en: to succeed one another, to be linked in sequence; (base sense of 係) copula 'to be', to pertain to
entries.notes: 汉字“係”本义为系属/系词，与西栏“相继互代”之衔接疑为“繫”（连系）之用，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 轮流、轮替；依次相代
entries.en: to take turns; to rotate, alternate in succession

entries.zh: 继承、接续；子承父位父业
entries.en: to inherit and continue; to succeed as a son to his father

entries.zh: 联结、相连不断；（世系上）父子相连相承
entries.en: to join, link together; linked succession of sons after fathers
entries.notes: “聯”本义连结，西栏“子承父”当为其世系引申义，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 遭凶、出变故；事情不顺
entries.en: to turn out ill; misfortune to befall
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:傾/頃]两可，音写 quen 与二字皆合，语义依西栏 Suceder mal 定。

entries.zh: 遭迍、遇困厄（“迍邅”之迍）
entries.en: to meet with adversity; to fare ill, be blocked on one's way

entries.zh: 遭逢厄难、历遇凶险
entries.en: to encounter misfortune and hardship

entries.zh: 活人行死路：活人走上死路，喻命蹇事乖、遭凶
entries.en: 'a living man walks the road of death' — one's fortunes to take a fatal turn, things to go ill
entries.notes: “行”之音号污損难辨（T99），余据汉字熟语与西栏 Suceder mal 互证，按规降低。

entries.zh: 有结尾、有收场；（西栏）结果良好、得善终
entries.en: to have an ending/conclusion; to turn out well

entries.zh: 掷筶得吉兆（疑“聖枉”为“聖杯”）：占问顺遂之兆
entries.en: a favorable omen in divination (sacred blocks, 'holy cup'); to have one's divination answered well
entries.notes: “枉”疑为“杯”之形误（sia pue 合闽南“聖杯”掷筶吉兆），西栏 lafuerte 疑为 suerte 之讹。

entries.zh: 选替、更代；职任上替换接任
entries.en: to replace/substitute in office; to take over another's post
entries.notes: 西栏“of° mo la gente finela”难以解读（of°=oficio），义依“擇替”二字与 Suceder en el oficio。

entries.zh: 应兆、兆验相符；征兆应验成事
entries.en: an omen to come true; the sign to correspond with the event
entries.notes: 西栏“lo Sosso”疑为 suceso（事验/结果）之讹，义依“應兆”与音写 eng siau。

entries.zh: 庙签、神前抽签；签现为吉凶之兆
entries.en: sacred temple lots; drawing lots as an omen/sign

entries.zh: 传继、传位；子承父业
entries.en: transmission of succession; for the son to succeed the father

entries.zh: 轮日、按日轮流；逐日相代
entries.en: to take turns by the day; alternate day by day

entries.zh: 轮流、轮换交替
entries.en: to take turns; to alternate in rotation
entries.notes: 音写 lun liu 之外另附 aue cy 两音节，与字栏两字未一一对当（或为句中另附词），不碍“輪流”本义。

entries.zh: 择换、选换更替；职任更换
entries.en: to choose and replace; change-over in a post

entries.zh: 相继勿绝：相承不断、接续不辍
entries.en: to succeed one another without break; unbroken succession

entries.zh: 承接、接续；前后相承
entries.en: to take over and carry on; to continue, follow one another

entries.zh: 相轮守更：轮流守更、轮班值夜
entries.en: to take turns keeping the night watch; to stand watch in rotation

entries.zh: 官帽（纱帽）相传；官职世袭、子继父任
entries.en: the official's cap handed down; hereditary succession to office, son succeeding father in government
entries.notes: “鐵紗帽”与西栏（子袭父职之政，句多讹乱：sucesnefe 等）之对应按语境推断。

entries.zh: 接续、延续；继而不绝
entries.en: to continue; to carry on, succeed without end
entries.notes: 西栏空缺，义依汉字“續”与音写 sion 及本页 Suceder/continuarse 语域，缺四栏互证。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [text lacunose; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 仅存西语词头（[疑:Sucenoy/Suceda]），汉字、闽南音写与官话栏俱空。
